liabilities_or_loans: Prohibitory Properties U/s 22-A(1)(B) under A.P. Registration Act, 1908
summary: This official communication from the Revenue Divisional Officer, Palasa to the District Collector, Srikakulam pertains to survey number 116/8 in Tallabhadra Village, Sompeta Mandal. Covering an extent of 0.67 acres, the property is classified as Government Poramboke / SWLA owned by the Revenue Department. The letter formally requests the inclusion of this land in the Section 22-A(1)(B) Prohibitory Properties list under the A.P. Registration Act, 1908.
full_raw_text: RDOPLS-LAND0SUR/9/2025-DT(LR)-RDOPLS I/180245/2025 Rc.No.1258/2025 DT (LR) 16-12-2025 Revenue Divisional Office, Palasa From Sri G.Venkatesh, B.Tech., Revenue Divisional Officer, Palasa Division. To The District Collector, Srikakulam. Sir, Sub:- Purification of 22 A - Inclusions -Srikakulam District - Palasa Division Sompeta Mandal - Tallabhadra Village - Request for inclusion of GOVT. lands in Sy.No.116/8 with an extent of Ac.0.67 in the list of Prohibitory Properties U/s 22 - A (1) (B) of Tallabhadra village - Proposals submitted - Reg. Ref:- 1) Instructions of the District Collector, Srikakulam during the RO's Conference dt:14.05.2025 2)Rc.No.267/2025 A dt:11.12.2025 of the Tahsildar, Sompeta . *** Kind attention is invited to the reference cited. It is submitted that in the reference 1st cited, the District Collector, Srikakulam has directed to verify the 22A Prohibited Properties for identification of the errors and rectifications if any and submit 22-A Prohibited properties proposals for notifying the same. It is submitted that in the reference 2nd cited, the Tahsildar, Sompeta has submitted a report stating that the field and Revenue permanent records was got verified and enquired by the gross root level and submitted their report stating that, the Sy.No.116/8 with an extent of Ac.0.67 cents is classified as "Poramboke" Land and recorded as SWLA in SLR and webland and requested to be added in 22 Annexures list of Tallabhadra Village of Sompeta Mandal, and the same entries were not entered in 22-A (1) (B) respectively. The Tahsildar, Sompeta has further reported that as verified the report of the Mandal Surveyor, asper the SFA,& Webland of the Tallabhadra Village, the subject land details are as follows: [Table 1: Sl. No.: 1 | Sy.No.: 116/8 | Land Classification as per SFA: Poramboke | Extent in Ac.: 0.67 | Enjoyer Name as per SFA: Government Land | Pattadar Name as per webland: Government Land | Extent in Ac.: 0.65] The Tahsildar, Sompeta also reported that, to add the entries in 22-(1) (B) and IGRS prohibited properties list of Tallabhadra Village of Sompeta Mandal. [Table 2: Sl. No.: 1 | Name of the Mandal: Sompeta | Name of the Village: Tallabhadra | Sy.No: 116/8 | Extent in Ac.: 0.67 | Name of the Assigned/Allottee/Owner: Revenue Department | Classification: SWLA] The Tahsildar, Sompeta has further reported that, as per the above table 1 & 2 stated that, the above said subject land the Sy.No.116/7 & 8 as per F.M.B of Tallabhadra Village of Sompeta Mandal converted to SWLA housing colony. However, it has not been entered in Sub Registrar Prohibitory list. The Tahsildar has requested that the SWLA lands be included in Sub Registrar Prohibitory list under A.P. Registration Act, 1908. Therefore, it is requested that, the above Govt Poramboke land SWLA in Sy.No.116/8 to an extent of Ac.0.67 cents of Tallabhadra Village, Sompeta Mandal kindly be included in Prohibitory property list in Section -22A(1) (B) under A.P. Registration Act, 1908. The Report of the Tahsildar, Sompeta and its enclosures are submitted herewith for kind perusal. Encls : As above Yours faithfully, GRANDHI VENKATESH Revenue Divisional Officer, Palasa Division Copy to the Tahsildar, Sompeta.
